text: Am wi my nephew the nicht, he's 4. His temp's 39.2 and I'm awfy feart. He's got the runs, but he's drinkin plenty and still peein normal. Says his throat's sair but he's managin his juice fine. His colour's normal, lips an aw, and his breathin's fine, nothin wrang there. I just dinnae ken if 39.2 is too high for a wee yin
